about: This title is included in Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box!

PlayStation®4 copies of Borderlands 3 include a digital upgrade to the fully optimized for PlayStation®5 version! Experience the game in gorgeous 4K resolution at up to 60 fps in single-player and online co-op.
Add more couch co-op mayhem with expanded local splitscreen support for up to 4 players.
The original shooter-looter returns, packing bazillions of guns and a mayhem-fueled adventure! Blast through new worlds and enemies as one of four new Vault Hunters.
Play solo or with friends to take on insane enemies, score loads of loot and save your home from the most ruthless cult leaders in the galaxy.
